description_en: Modifies the SQL audit settings of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 修改集群的SQL审计日志设置
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-audit-log-config --db-cluster-id amv-t4nj8619bz2w30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --audit-log-status on --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status to which you want to change the SQL audit feature. Valid values:

on
off

After you disable the SQL audit feature, all SQL audit logs are deleted. You must query and export SQL audit logs before you disable SQL audit. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612426.html. When you re-enable SQL audit, audit logs that are generated from the time when SQL audit was last enabled are available for queries
parameters.help_zh:
修改SQL审计日志的状态。取值说明：
on：开启SQL审计。
off：关闭SQL审计。

SQL审计功能关闭后，SQL审计日志会被清空。请先查询和导出SQL审计日志，再关闭SQL审计功能。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612426.html。当再次打开审计日志，审计日志将从最近一次打开审计日志的时间开始展示
parameters.name: audit_log_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the compute engine. Valid values:

XIHE (default)
SPARK
parameters.help_zh:
计算引擎类型。取值说明：

XIHE（默认值）：羲和计算引擎。
SPARK：Spark计算引擎
parameters.name: engine_type

UpdateSucceed.description_en:
Indicates whether the status of SQL audit is updated. Valid values:

true
false
UpdateSucceed.description_zh:
是否已更新SQL审计的开启状态。取值说明：
true：状态已更新。
false：状态更新失败
